evidence_commit_relation: This evidence file is committed after the implementation/content commits and before generated-face materialization.

facets.F1_correctness: Adds a pure Cloud KMS operator reconcile kernel, transient kube-rs adapter projection/actuation seam, live dynamic-CRD controller runtime, app binary wiring, CRDs, operator deployment, SLO, and runbook aligned to the lane brief. CRD specs now drive desired state in the live runtime; fresh CRs without controller-written status reconcile as not-yet-created resources. Successful create/rotate/sealing-root/demote/quarantine actions now write CRD status patches so the next cycle converges instead of repeating stale work, and stale retries repair status without duplicate domain creates, rotations, or sealing-root creates. Kernel and domain tests cover create, rotate, sealing-root create, demote, quarantine, partial observation, and idempotency.
facets.F2_tests: Focused Buck2 tests passed for the Cloud KMS domain, operator kernel, adapter, and app: 67 tests total. The kube-enabled app binary target builds. YAML/JSON parsing passed for values, CRDs, SLO, evidence, and generated faces.
facets.F3_maintainability: The reconcile decision function is pure and isolated from kube-rs. Runtime dependencies sit behind provider/actuator traits and the transient ADR-0510 adapter; fake-provider seams and hard-coded desired-state fixtures remain test-only.
facets.F4_compatibility: New crates are added under the workspace glob pattern and expose Buck2 targets without editing shared workspace member lists. Existing cloud-kms API/domain crates are reused rather than replaced. Buck and Cargo dependency declarations both include the kube-rs runtime surface in the transient adapter.
facets.F5_security: No credentials are added. Production source scans found no panicking unwrap/expect paths and no shell command execution in the operator app/adapter/kernel surfaces. The operator pod drops Linux capabilities, runs as non-root, uses read-only root filesystem, mounts mTLS material read-only, and the binary fails startup if the expected mTLS files or durable state path are absent.
facets.F6_privacy: No user or tenant personal data processing changes. New structs carry data_class comments for control-plane fields.
facets.F7_operability: Adds operator CRDs, RBAC, PDB, resource limits, mTLS volume wiring, durable operator state PVC wiring, reconcile convergence SLO, and a console/API-only stuck-reconcile runbook. The chart defaults the operator to one replica until Kubernetes Lease-based leader election exists.
facets.F8_performance: Reconcile remains linear over desired/observed key rings and versions; no data-plane path is introduced. SLO bounds control-plane convergence only.
facets.F9_compliance: Fail-closed behavior for partial/ambiguous list or projection failures is explicit and tested. Missing status on a fresh CR is treated as absent backing state, not as an API read failure; present but incomplete status fails closed. The live domain actuator derives desired state from CRDs, including sealing roots, and executes key-ring create/rotate, sealing-root create, decrypt-only demotion, and key-ring quarantine through Cloud KMS domain lifecycle ports. Runbook instructs operators not to manually mutate key material outside the Cloud KMS API console.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of additive crates/manifests/docs plus generated-face settle output; no database migration or production state mutation is introduced.
facets.F11_observability: The live runtime emits one structured tracing wide-event for success, reconcile failure, or observation failure paths, and the SLO/runbook reference `cloud_kms_operator_reconcile` as the operational event. The Prometheus histogram is marked target-only until the exporter mapping lands.
facets.F13_migration: The adapter is ADR-0510-marked as transient kube-rs isolation pending the owned cloud-k8s port cutover.
facets.M1_challenge_assumption: Rejected hard-coded key region/origin in rotate actuation by changing the kernel action payload to carry the full desired key ring.
facets.M2_zoomed_out_fit: Keeps the operator as a control-plane reconciliation layer over existing Cloud KMS domain APIs, not a new cryptographic or HSM implementation.

hyperscaler_lens.canonical: operator decisions are pure-kernel and adapter-driven, with CRDs and GitOps manifests as the public control-plane contract
hyperscaler_lens.cloud_native: namespaced CRDs, Deployment, RBAC, PDB, mTLS volume, and OpenSLO fit the Kubernetes/GitOps operating model
hyperscaler_lens.hermetic: CI-relevant behavior is validated with fake providers plus kube-enabled Buck2 targets; no live cluster is required for tests
hyperscaler_lens.public_product: typed desired/observed state and runbook/SLO artifacts make the reconcile contract inspectable for operators and reviewers

known_gaps: specs/multispectrum-review.json is absent in this checkout, so this file follows the existing 2.4-compatible evidence shape used under evidence/multispectrum.
helm is not installed locally; chart validation used YAML parsing for values/CRDs/SLO and template structure inspection instead of helm lint.
The Prometheus histogram in cloud-kms-reconcile-convergence is target-only in this slice; the live runtime currently emits structured tracing fields including convergence_seconds.
Kubernetes Lease-based leader election is not implemented in this slice; the chart defaults the operator to one replica to preserve single-writer behavior.
Remote oya-ci-required/cloud-ci required context and reviewer approval remain pending until PR creation.

fixed_high_findings: Partial CRD status now fails closed when status is present but missing health, versions, or observedVersion.
Successful create/rotate actions now produce CRD status patches; fresh key-ring two-cycle convergence is covered by a regression test.
Operator-created domain keys now use the reconcile clock timestamp instead of epoch zero.
The operator Helm values default to one replica until leader election is implemented.
Stale retries after a domain-side create or rotate repair status without duplicate domain creates or version advances.
Production startup now requires a durable operator state path and uses PersistentCloudKmsDirectory instead of an in-memory CloudKmsDirectory default.
Live KmsSealingRoot, decrypt-only demotion, and key-ring quarantine actions now execute through Cloud KMS domain lifecycle ports with adapter integration tests.
Stale retries after a domain-side sealing-root create now repair status without a duplicate domain create.
Branch history was consolidated so content and evidence commits precede a single final generated-face settle commit.
pre_pr_adversarial_review.signature_evidence: All branch commit headers contain gpgsig BEGIN SSH SIGNATURE; read-only codex review sandbox could not create Git verifier temp files.

explicit_non_claims: No live Kubernetes cluster was contacted.
No manual edit to any *.generated.json file was made.
No Prometheus histogram exporter mapping is claimed live in this slice.
No multi-replica high-availability claim is made; leader election remains future work and this chart defaults to one replica.
No live Cloud KMS provider, HSM, or Kubernetes cluster mutation was performed; verification used fake providers, domain directory state, and Buck2 tests.
